content.text:
資料だけを使い、指定schemaのJSONを一つ返す。A/Bは役が担当する対象の区別で、人物を統合しない。origin_idは観測原票の出典である。版は観測者ごとに比較し、出典IDの字面から人物・版を推測しない。全必須欄を出力する。説明文、操作、外部参照は禁止。
保存されたmemoryとprocessingだけを読む。mascotは本人customerのanimal、customer_origin_idはその出典。shared_note.coverageのACTIVE行をactive_coverageへ全欄で列挙し、REVOKEDの観測者をrevoked_observersへ列挙する。配列の順序は任意。
processingがUNRESOLVEDなら、pending_notice_idsにそのnotice_idを入れ、channel=UNKNOWN、channel_status=PENDING。対象不明の撤回が共同判断の根拠へ影響し得るためである。MATCHEDならpending_notice_idsは空で、A/Bどちらかの共同観測がREVOKEDならchannel=UNKNOWN、channel_status=WITHDRAWN。
未解決も失効もなく、両観測者でALLの媒体が一つだけならそれをchannelへ、channel_status=READY。媒体が一意でない場合もchannel=UNKNOWNとする。保留の場合も、本人の好みや有効な観測行は読み取って答える。
{"type": "object", "properties": {"mascot": {"enum": ["DOG", "CAT", "UNKNOWN"]}, "customer_origin_id": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}, "channel": {"enum": ["PAPER", "DIGITAL", "UNKNOWN"]}, "channel_status": {"enum": ["READY", "WITHDRAWN", "PENDING"]}, "active_coverage": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"observer": {"enum": ["A", "B", "UNKNOWN"]}, "paper": {"enum": ["ALL", "NOT_ALL", "UNKNOWN"]}, "digital": {"enum": ["ALL", "NOT_ALL", "UNKNOWN"]}, "origin_id": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}, "revision": {"enum": [1, 2, 3, 4, "UNKNOWN"]}, "status": {"enum": ["ACTIVE", "REVOKED"]}}, "required": ["observer", "paper", "digital", "origin_id", "revision", "status"], "additionalProperties": false}, "maxItems": 2, "uniqueItems": true}, "revoked_observers": {"type": "array", "items": {"enum": ["A", "B"]}, "maxItems": 2, "uniqueItems": true}, "pending_notice_ids": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}, "maxItems": 1, "uniqueItems": true}}, "required": ["mascot", "customer_origin_id", "channel", "channel_status", "active_coverage", "revoked_observers", "pending_notice_ids"], "additionalProperties": false}

{"holder":"B","item":"個別の案内カード","memory":{"private_note":{"coverage":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"B","origin_id":"RF8484F72E99C8EE","paper":"ALL","revision":3,"status":"REVOKED"},"customer":{"animal":"CAT","origin_id":"RD859AA140D57CA8","subject":"B"}},"shared_note":{"coverage":{"A":{"digital":"NOT_ALL","observer":"A","origin_id":"R1860784DF2A1BCB","paper":"ALL","revision":3,"status":"ACTIVE"},"B":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"B","origin_id":"RF8484F72E99C8EE","paper":"ALL","revision":3,"status":"REVOKED"}}}},"processing":{"basis":"DETAILS","matched_observer":"B","notice_id":"R555A3CB31B18E35","resolution":"MATCHED","target_origin_id":"R85B4DD951389AAE"},"scene":"音楽鑑賞会・撤回診断用の別開催"}
